docs.summary: Editor-wide scene-view tool state, shared by the built-in transform gizmo, the toolbar, the shortcut handlers and any custom scene tool. This is deliberately global rather than per-panel: the active tool and snap settings are a property of the editor session, matching how the toolbar and hotkeys already behave, and a custom tool needs to read them without holding a panel reference.
Fires whenever any tool state changes, so panels can rebuild cached gizmo state.
